description: Saskatoon's 2024 Civic Services Survey shows 84% resident satisfaction.
Top concerns are homelessness, crime, and public safety.
Council requested survey data for diverse communities and by ward.

chips.text: Councillor Dubois urged immediate action on customer service; staff suggested strategic planning.
Why customer service and public engagement satisfaction scores declined remains unclear.
Current survey methodology may not fully represent diverse or low-income residents.
Administration will investigate customer service declines and take interim actions.

description: Council reviews and prioritizes projects for GPC's 2025 work plan.
Council can remove items from the GPC 2025 work plan.

chips.text: Council can remove items from the referral list without a separate notice of motion.

description: David Fineday advocated for Indigenous-led support for unhoused people.
City staff updated on $4.5 million for housing and navigation hub study.
Discussion covered service access and reasons for choosing to live rough.

chips.text: Mayor Block expressed concern about the city's communication strategy for unhoused residents.
Roughly 36% of unhoused individuals choose to live rough, often on the east side.
Question raised about establishing a homeless shelter on the city's east side.
David Fineday, a hereditary chief, shared personal stories of friends lost to homelessness.

description: Committee reported on its private, in-camera meeting.

chips.text: Councillor Parker declared a conflict of interest for 2025 library appointments.
